concept: A container gives content an ordinary maximum width and side margins, so panes sit in a page rather than stretching edge to edge.

root.why: centred with margins that grow at each breakpoint, so content never touches the screen edge

s-sm.why: small width for forms and single-column reading, where lines must stay short

s-md.why: medium width for a feed or a settings column

s-lg.why: large width for two panes side by side

s-xl.why: extra large width for dashboards of several panes

s-2xl.why: widest setting for full app layouts on large screens, still capped so lines stay readable
